Order Confirmation & Tracking for React

Order Status is the page a customer lands on after checkout and comes back to while they wait. OrderConfirmation says thanks by name, shows the order number, the email the receipt went to, the expected delivery dates, what they bought and where it’s going. A check mark draws in and the details rise into place in about 800 ms, and content is readable well before that.
OrderConfirmation
OrderTracking

OrderTracking follows Baymard’s six tracking essentials. Each package gets a card with a large delivery date, a progress bar that shows before anything ships, the carrier and a linked tracking number you can copy, what’s inside with thumbnails, and the full shipping history newest first. Split orders read Package 1 of 2, and items that haven’t shipped sit in their own Preparing to ship card.

Problems are spelled out rather than hidden. A delayed shipment turns its step amber and says the new date, a missed delivery says when the next attempt is, a cancelled order says whether the payment was released or refunded, and a pending payment says nothing ships until it clears.
Reason options. note shows a text box for details.
ReturnRequest

ReturnRequest is a two-step return: pick items and quantities, then a reason and where the refund goes. Final-sale items, items still in transit and items past the return window stay visible but disabled, each with the reason. The refund estimate updates as you choose, including the discount and tax share and any return shipping fee, and the confirmation shows a drop-off code and the refund timeline.

ReturnRequest posts the chosen lines, reason and refund method to your endpoint and shows the label it returns. Throw with a message and it appears next to the submit button, with everything the customer picked still in place.
